name: data-raw/00_export_seaurchin.R
content:
# seaurchin/data-raw/00_export_seaurchin.R
# Offline export of posterior parameter draws and derived quantities from the
# Andalividus brms fits into compact gzipped CSVs that the Shinylive bundle can
# load and re-evaluate client-side. Run once; the produced files in
# seaurchin/data/ are the only artefacts shipped with the deployed app.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(here)
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
    library(posterior)
})

# Base R CSV writer that emits a UTF-8, quoted, no-row-name file. Used in
# both gzipped and plain modes to avoid the vroom binary dependency that
# readr brings in.
write_csv_base <- function(x, path) {
    utils::write.csv(x, file = path, row.names = FALSE,
                     quote = TRUE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
    invisible(path)
}

write_csv_gz <- function(x, path) {
    stopifnot(grepl("\\.csv$", path))
    gz_path <- paste0(path, ".gz")
    con <- gzfile(gz_path, open = "wt", encoding = "UTF-8")
    on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
    utils::write.csv(x, file = con, row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
    invisible(gz_path)
}

# Light replacement for readr::read_csv for the summary step (uses base
# read.csv which does not depend on vroom).
read_csv_gz <- function(path) {
    con <- gzfile(path, open = "rt", encoding = "UTF-8")
    on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
    utils::read.csv(con, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

andalividus_root <- here::here()
out_dir <- here::here("seaurchin", "data")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

log_offset_mg_L <- function() 1e-3
thin_step       <- 4L   # 4000 post-warmup draws thinned to 1000 for shipping
pops            <- c("Malaga", "Cadiz")
creams          <- c("C", "E1", "E2")

# ============================ #
# 1. parameter draws per endpoint  ####
# ============================ #

extract_params <- function(fit) {
    d <- posterior::as_draws_df(fit)
    rows <- list()
    for (p in pops) for (s in creams) {
        suffix <- paste0("population", p, ":sunscreen", s)
        col_pminLo <- paste0("b_pminLo_", suffix)
        col_pmaxLo <- paste0("b_pmaxLo_", suffix)
        col_lEC    <- paste0("b_lEC_",    suffix)
        col_b      <- paste0("b_b_",      suffix)
        stopifnot(all(c(col_pminLo, col_pmaxLo, col_lEC, col_b) %in% colnames(d)))
        rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(
            draw       = d$`.draw`,
            population = p,
            sunscreen  = s,
            pminLo     = d[[col_pminLo]],
            pmaxLo     = d[[col_pmaxLo]],
            lEC        = d[[col_lEC]],
            b          = d[[col_b]]
        )
    }
    dplyr::bind_rows(rows) |>
        dplyr::filter(draw %% thin_step == 0L) |>
        dplyr::arrange(population, sunscreen, draw)
}

for (endpoint in c("fert", "larva")) {
    fit_path <- file.path(andalividus_root, "cache",
                          paste0("fit_", endpoint, ".rds"))
    cat(sprintf("[params] loading %s\n", basename(fit_path)))
    fit  <- readRDS(fit_path)
    pars <- extract_params(fit)
    csv_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("params_draws_", endpoint, ".csv"))
    write_csv_gz(pars, csv_path)
    cat(sprintf("[params] wrote %s (%d rows)\n",
                paste0(basename(csv_path), ".gz"), nrow(pars)))
    rm(fit, pars); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
}

# ============================ #
# 2. pred grid (posterior dose-response on canonical log10 grid) ####
# ============================ #

for (endpoint in c("fert", "larva")) {
    src <- file.path(andalividus_root, "cache",
                     paste0("pred_", endpoint, ".rds"))
    g <- readRDS(src) |>
        dplyr::select(population, sunscreen, log10c, concentration_mg_L,
                      median, lower, upper) |>
        dplyr::mutate(concentration_mg_L = 10^log10c - log_offset_mg_L())
    csv_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("pred_grid_", endpoint, ".csv"))
    write_csv_gz(g, csv_path)
    cat(sprintf("[pred] wrote %s (%d rows)\n",
                paste0(basename(csv_path), ".gz"), nrow(g)))
}

# ============================ #
# 3. EC draws (thinned to match params) ####
# ============================ #

for (endpoint in c("fert", "larva")) {
    src <- file.path(andalividus_root, "cache",
                     paste0("ecx_", endpoint, "_draws.rds"))
    e <- readRDS(src) |>
        dplyr::filter(draw %% thin_step == 0L) |>
        dplyr::arrange(population, sunscreen, level, draw)
    csv_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("ecx_draws_", endpoint, ".csv"))
    write_csv_gz(e, csv_path)
    cat(sprintf("[ecx] wrote %s (%d rows)\n",
                paste0(basename(csv_path), ".gz"), nrow(e)))
}

# ============================ #
# 4. PSR draws (thinned) ####
# ============================ #

for (endpoint in c("fert", "larva")) {
    src <- file.path(andalividus_root, "cache",
                     paste0("psr_", endpoint, "_draws.rds"))
    p <- readRDS(src) |>
        dplyr::filter(draw %% thin_step == 0L) |>
        dplyr::select(sunscreen, draw, Malaga, Cadiz, psr, log10_psr) |>
        dplyr::arrange(sunscreen, draw)
    csv_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("psr_draws_", endpoint, ".csv"))
    write_csv_gz(p, csv_path)
    cat(sprintf("[psr] wrote %s (%d rows)\n",
                paste0(basename(csv_path), ".gz"), nrow(p)))
}

# ============================ #
# 5. precomputed summaries (fast hero/EC rendering) ####
# ============================ #

ecx_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    read_csv_gz(file.path(out_dir, "ecx_draws_fert.csv.gz")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(endpoint = "fertilisation"),
    read_csv_gz(file.path(out_dir, "ecx_draws_larva.csv.gz")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(endpoint = "larva")
) |>
    dplyr::group_by(endpoint, population, sunscreen, level) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
        median = median(ecx_mg_L, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower  = stats::quantile(ecx_mg_L, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
        upper  = stats::quantile(ecx_mg_L, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )
write_csv_base(ecx_summary, file.path(out_dir, "ecx_summary.csv"))
cat(sprintf("[summary] wrote ecx_summary.csv (%d rows)\n", nrow(ecx_summary)))

psr_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    read_csv_gz(file.path(out_dir, "psr_draws_fert.csv.gz")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(endpoint = "fertilisation"),
    read_csv_gz(file.path(out_dir, "psr_draws_larva.csv.gz")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(endpoint = "larva")
) |>
    dplyr::group_by(endpoint, sunscreen) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
        psr_median   = median(psr, na.rm = TRUE),
        psr_lower    = stats::quantile(psr, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
        psr_upper    = stats::quantile(psr, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
        prob_psr_lt_1 = mean(psr < 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )
write_csv_base(psr_summary, file.path(out_dir, "psr_summary.csv"))
cat(sprintf("[summary] wrote psr_summary.csv (%d rows)\n", nrow(psr_summary)))

# ============================ #
# 6. raw data and metadata (verbatim copies) ####
# ============================ #

file.copy(file.path(andalividus_root, "data", "ecotox_long.csv"),
          file.path(out_dir, "raw_long.csv"),
          overwrite = TRUE)
file.copy(file.path(andalividus_root, "data", "site_meta.csv"),
          file.path(out_dir, "site_meta.csv"),
          overwrite = TRUE)
file.copy(file.path(andalividus_root, "data", "sunscreen_meta.csv"),
          file.path(out_dir, "sunscreen_meta.csv"),
          overwrite = TRUE)
cat("[copy] raw_long.csv, site_meta.csv, sunscreen_meta.csv\n")

# ============================ #
# 7. payload audit  ####
# ============================ #

files <- list.files(out_dir, full.names = TRUE)
sizes <- file.info(files)$size
audit <- tibble::tibble(
    file = basename(files),
    size_kB = round(sizes / 1024, 1)
) |> dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(size_kB))
print(audit)
cat(sprintf("[total] %.1f kB\n", sum(sizes) / 1024))

name: tests/testthat/setup-helpers.R
content:
# tests/testthat/setup-helpers.R
# testthat auto-sources every setup-*.R before the test suite. Binds the
# seaurchin R/ helpers into the global environment so individual test files
# do not need their own source() calls.

# Anchor to seaurchin/ explicitly. here::here() would walk up to the parent
# Andalividus.Rproj and resolve R/ to the wrong directory.
seaurchin_root <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(parent.frame()$ofile %||% "."),
                                          "..", ".."),
                                mustWork = FALSE)
if (!dir.exists(file.path(seaurchin_root, "R"))) {
    # Fallback when sourced without ofile context (e.g. testthat 3.x): walk
    # from the current working directory.
    seaurchin_root <- normalizePath("../..", mustWork = TRUE)
}
for (f in list.files(file.path(seaurchin_root, "R"),
                     pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) {
    sys.source(f, envir = globalenv())
}
options(seaurchin.root = seaurchin_root)

name: tests/testthat/test_eval_4pl.R
content:
# tests/testthat/test_eval_4pl.R
# Regression checks on the client-side 4PL forward and inverse helpers.
# Run from the seaurchin/ directory:
#   Rscript -e 'testthat::test_dir("tests/testthat")'

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(testthat)
    library(dplyr)
})

ROOT     <- getOption("seaurchin.root", normalizePath("../..", mustWork = TRUE))
DATA_DIR <- file.path(ROOT, "data")

test_that("EC50 recovery on the canonical cell Malaga x C x larval development", {
    pars <- read_csv_gz(file.path(DATA_DIR, "params_draws_larva.csv.gz"))
    cell <- pars[pars$population == "Malaga" & pars$sunscreen == "C", ,
                 drop = FALSE]
    ecx <- compute_ecx_draws(cell, x_levels = 0.50)$EC50
    ec50_median <- stats::median(ecx, na.rm = TRUE)
    expect_lt(abs(ec50_median - 8.91), 0.3)
})

test_that("Forward 4PL at EC50 equals (pmin + pmax) / 2 to two decimals", {
    pars <- read_csv_gz(file.path(DATA_DIR, "params_draws_larva.csv.gz"))
    cell <- pars[pars$population == "Malaga" & pars$sunscreen == "C", ,
                 drop = FALSE]
    lEC_med <- stats::median(cell$lEC, na.rm = TRUE)
    pred <- eval_4pl(cell, lEC_med)
    p_med <- stats::median(pred[, 1], na.rm = TRUE)
    pmin_med <- stats::median(plogis(cell$pminLo), na.rm = TRUE)
    pmax_med <- stats::median(plogis(cell$pmaxLo), na.rm = TRUE)
    expect_lt(abs(p_med - (pmin_med + pmax_med) / 2), 0.01)
})

test_that("Posterior tail probabilities are bounded in [0, 1]", {
    psr <- read_csv_gz(file.path(DATA_DIR, "psr_draws_fert.csv.gz"))
    p <- tail_prob(psr$psr, 1, side = "<")
    expect_true(is.numeric(p) && p >= 0 && p <= 1)
})

test_that("parse_concentrations is robust to mixed separators and bad input", {
    expect_equal(parse_concentrations("1, 5, 10, 50"), c(1, 5, 10, 50))
    expect_equal(parse_concentrations("1;5;10"), c(1, 5, 10))
    expect_equal(parse_concentrations("1 5  10"), c(1, 5, 10))
    expect_equal(parse_concentrations("1, -2, foo, 5"), c(1, 5))
    expect_equal(parse_concentrations(""), numeric(0))
    expect_equal(parse_concentrations(NULL), numeric(0))
})

test_that("Bilingual dictionary has no missing keys across languages", {
    keys_en <- names(i18n_dict$en)
    keys_es <- names(i18n_dict$es)
    missing_in_es <- setdiff(keys_en, keys_es)
    missing_in_en <- setdiff(keys_es, keys_en)
    expect_equal(missing_in_es, character(0))
    expect_equal(missing_in_en, character(0))
})
